description: Helper functions for testing git bitmap performance, including functions for full bitmap, partial bitmap, and pack bitmap tests, primarily invoking git commands to measure and verify performance characteristics.

methods.name: test_full_bitmap
methods.description: Runs a series of performance tests related to full bitmap indexing in git, including pack-objects commands and rev-list commands with various filters.

methods.name: test_partial_bitmap
methods.description: Runs performance tests for partial bitmap scenarios, including pack-objects with bitmap index and rev-list with filters.

methods.name: test_pack_bitmap
methods.description: Performs packing and bitmap tests, including repacking and setting up specific git repository states for testing bitmap performance.
